learner_starting_state: Can explain generative model behavior and write small functions but may mix durable instructions, user tasks, evidence, and output requirements.
learner_ending_state: Can separate system and user roles, add grounding and an output contract, handle instruction conflict safely, and define a realistic prompt evaluation set.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on primary and fresh-transfer forms across six prompt-design decisions, including destructive-action and prompt-injection safeguards, then explain one improved prompt without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: AI-901 scope and current system/prompt guidance trace to official Microsoft sources; scenarios, reasons, and gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify current model-specific prompt guidance, supported roles/parameters, context limits, safety features, SDK/API shapes, and deprecations before live use.

notes: Offline prompt-design package; sends no prompt to a service and authorizes no external action.
